about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Engineer first. Security as part of the architecture, not an afterthought.
about.description: I'm Emmanuel Galadima, a seasoned software engineer architecting robust solutions at the intersection of complex systems. My expertise spans full-stack engineering, specialized AI application development, and resilient product engineering. With a strong foundation in application security and Web3/blockchain technologies, I design secure, decentralized, and intelligent systems that scale. I bridge the gap between rigorous technical execution and impactful product vision.
points: Full-stack applications: React, Next.js, TypeScript, APIs, databases, complex interfaces

Product engineering: from concept to architecture to implementation to deployment
Application security: authentication, authorization, security architecture, data protection
Web3 & blockchain: TON, smart contracts, blockchain applications and research

ai-construction-takeoff.title: AI Construction & Takeoff Platform
ai-construction-takeoff.summary: A production AI platform that reads construction blueprints and PDFs, performs AI-assisted quantity takeoff, and manages project workflows.

problem.title: The Problem
problem.body: Construction quantity takeoff is manual, slow, and error-prone. Reading blueprints, extracting measurements, and estimating material quantities by hand takes hours and is a bottleneck for project teams.

approach.title: The Approach
approach.body: I built a system that combines multimodal document processing with AI-assisted takeoff — reading blueprints and PDFs, extracting quantities with AI, and routing the work through an orchestrated set of agents and workflows.

architecture.title: Architecture & Engineering
architecture.body: A full-stack application with a database-driven architecture for persistent state, an AI agent orchestration layer, an export pipeline, and a complex interactive UI for reviewing and managing takeoff workflows.

stack.title: Stack
stack.body: Next.js, TypeScript, Gemini for multimodal understanding, PostgreSQL for persistent data, and an orchestrated AI agent pipeline.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.body: A flagship product that demonstrates end-to-end engineering — AI integration, data architecture, agent orchestration, and a usable interface working together as one system.

next.title: What I'd Do Next
next.body: Add richer blueprint visualization, deeper integration with project-management tools, and tighter security and authorization controls across teams.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Answers about how I work, my approach to AI, and how I think about security.

items.question: What kind of projects do you build?
items.answer: Full-stack software systems — from complex web applications and AI-powered workflows to secure backend infrastructure and blockchain applications. I take a product idea, architect the system, build it, integrate AI and data, deploy it, and keep security in mind throughout.

items.question: Are you a cybersecurity engineer?
items.answer: My primary focus is full-stack software engineering. I build applications with security considered as part of the architecture — authentication, authorization, security headers, access control, and secure design — rather than treating security as an afterthought.

items.question: How do you use AI in your work?
items.answer: I engineer applications that use AI as part of the product — AI agents, multimodal document processing, LLM integrations, and orchestration — rather than simply using AI tools to make websites.

items.question: Can you work on a product from idea to launch?
items.answer: Yes. Product engineering is one of my core capabilities — taking an idea from concept through architecture, implementation, and deployment.
